issues.basis: NL1 contract, inspection_equivalent_facts reachability[*]->UnspecifiedInitial, STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL for DoorShut, transition:line:17
issues.expected: Root initial entry must enter DoorShut as the microwave start state.

issues.reason: The NL and PlantUML specify DoorShut as the start state, but the closed FCSTM initial pseudostate targets UnspecifiedInitial and inspection shows DoorShut unreachable from initial.
issues.requirement_quote: The microwave starts in the DoorShut state. From this state, the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed or transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: PlantUML marks DoorShut <<initial>>; author source intends DoorShut as start.
issues.title: Microwave initial entry targets UnspecifiedInitial not DoorShut

issues.basis: NL2 contract, exact_source_inventory.transitions, fcstm_model transitions list
issues.expected: A transition from DoorOpen to DoorShut on door closed must exist.
issues.observed: FCSTM contains no DoorOpen->DoorShut transition; source inventory contains no such transition.
issues.reason: The NL requires a return transition DoorOpen->DoorShut, but the exact source inventory and closed model lack that endpoint pair, a cross-context inconsistency.
issues.requirement_quote: When the Door Opened action occurs in the DoorShut state, the system transitions to the DoorOpen state. The door can be closed to return to the DoorShut state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: NL2 states the return path; source PlantUML lacks it, indicating a contrastive inconsistency.
issues.title: DoorOpen to DoorShut on door closed missing in model and source
